content.text: Grafana board points at it; closed after a week of matching hand-checked depths.
On-call currently scrapes worker logs or Redis CLI to judge backlog severity. A stable ops signal is needed for dashboards and autoscaling.
Add GET /v2/ops/worker-queues (ops-scoped token only) returning per-queue depth, oldest_job_age_seconds, and inflight for each named topic. Read-only, no job payloads.
Acceptance: authorized ops tokens only (403 otherwise); p99 latency under 100ms; metrics match Redis LLEN within a 2s skew; runbook updated.
